Projects.title: PKBM Swastika School Website
desc: The official website of PKBM Swastika, a non-formal education center in Malang that runs equivalency programs for elementary (Paket A), junior high (Paket B), and senior high (Paket C) levels, plus skills training.
The site presents the education programs, a step-by-step registration flow with required documents, an FAQ, news and announcements, an activity gallery with category filters, and contact information.
Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS with a responsive layout, and live on the school's own domain at pkbmswastika.sch.id.

Projects.title: Online Student Admission System (PPDB) MTsN Kota Batu
desc: A web-based new student admission system (PPDB/PMBM) for MTsN Kota Batu. Applicants register online through a six-step form covering terms, student data, parent or guardian data, previous school, admission track (Prestasi, Tahfidz, Ma'had, and others), and report card grades.

Registered applicants log in to a student panel to complete their biodata, upload required documents, check announcements, and print their registration card, grade summary, and acceptance letter as PDF.

The admin panel lets the committee verify applicants, open or close registration, set announcements and exam schedules, export applicant data and grades to Excel, and follow registration statistics per month and per year in interactive charts.

Projects.title: Mac and Cheese Si Mbok Landing Page
desc: A landing page concept for Mac and Cheese Si Mbok, a homemade mac and cheese brand. The page covers the hero, menu categories, best-selling menu with prices, a limited-time promo, the brand story with a testimonial, an Instagram feed, outlet locations with opening hours, and WhatsApp ordering.

The project includes a style guide page that documents the visual system: color tokens checked for WCAG AA contrast, typography, spacing, radius and shadows, and every UI component used on the page, prepared so the design can be moved to Next.js and Tailwind.

Built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript with shared design tokens, scroll animations, and a responsive layout for laptop, tablet, and phone. Names, addresses, phone numbers, and testimonials are fictional, and the photo sources and licenses are listed on a credits page.

Projects.title: Tinta Wedding Digital Invitation Templates
desc: Tinta Wedding is a collection of more than 15 digital wedding invitation templates, each with its own visual theme, such as Ivory Vellum, Terracotta Modern, Cinematic Editorial, Dark Botanical Luxe, Royal Javanese Heritage, and Islamic Arabesque Gold.

Each template is driven by a single CONFIG object that holds the couple, events, love story, gallery, and bank accounts, so a new invitation only needs a data change. Decorations are hand-coded as inline SVG, and animations use GSAP and ScrollTrigger while respecting reduced-motion settings.

Features include the guest name taken from the link, an animated opening cover, a countdown, event details with map links, a photo slideshow and lightbox gallery, a guestbook with RSVP, a digital envelope with copy-to-clipboard, background music, and a live streaming section. Some templates are built with Next.js and send RSVPs to Google Sheets through Google Apps Script. All names and photos in the previews are placeholders.

Projects.title: Building Damage Level Detection with LBP & PCA
desc: An image analysis project that classifies building damage into minor, moderate, or severe from a single photo. Each image is converted to grayscale, resized, and split into a 5x5 grid, then texture features are extracted with a manually implemented multi-scale Local Binary Pattern (LBP) at radius 1 to 5.

For every grid cell, the normalized LBP histogram is summarized into five statistics (mean, variance, entropy, energy, skewness). The features are standardized and reduced with Principal Component Analysis, where PC1 alone explains 91.82% of the variance.
PC1 values are normalized and mapped to damage categories, and the final label is decided by majority vote across the grid. The clustering is validated with a Silhouette Score of 0.72.

Projects.title: Facial Emotion Detection
desc: A facial emotion detection system that recognizes three expressions: angry (marah), sad (sedih), and happy (senang). Faces, eyes, and mouths are located with Haar Cascade classifiers, then 35 features are extracted from eye and mouth regions, texture, edges, histograms, and gradients.
The model is an ensemble of Random Forest and KNN trained on 317 images, reaching 70.31% accuracy, with the best results on the happy class (86% precision, 95% recall).
The model is served through a Flask web app with drag-and-drop upload. It shows the detected keypoints, a confidence score per emotion, and an explanation of why an emotion was predicted.

Projects.title: Global YouTube Statistics 2023 Analysis
desc: Exploratory data analysis of the Global YouTube Statistics 2023 dataset (995 top channels, 28 columns), covering subscribers, video views, earnings, channel types, countries, and creation dates.

The analysis compares subscribers by category and country, earnings by channel type, growth over time, and correlations between variables. Subscribers and video views are strongly correlated, and earnings follow the same pattern.
After cleaning missing values, duplicates, and outliers, a simple linear regression using video views and highest monthly earnings explains about 39% of the variance in subscribers (R² 0.39).

Projects.title: Kimia Farma Business Performance Dashboard
desc: Final project of the Kimia Farma Big Data Analytics virtual internship with Rakamin Academy. Transaction, product, inventory, and branch data were combined into an analysis table to evaluate Kimia Farma's business performance from 2020 to 2023.

The interactive dashboard shows total transactions (672,458), branches across 70 cities and 31 provinces, the share of each branch type, the top provinces by transactions and sales, and revenue per year, with filters by month, province, and product.

Projects.title: Shipping Decision Support System (TOPSIS)
desc: A web-based decision support system for choosing shipping options using the TOPSIS method. Users manage criteria, weights, rating scales, alternatives, and scores, and the system ranks the alternatives.
